McGreen et al. 2024 (PMID 38309625) meta-analysed 32 Go/No-Go and Stop-Signal studies for appetitive behaviour (g=-0.21), not cognitive-training transfer; Go/No-Go already covers inhibition. No evidence-table record was added, so the review remains at 120 records and 282 outcomes.
